messages.subject: Newbie question on ggplot2 book
parts:
Hello...

This is a question regarding an example in the ggplot2 book by Wickham
on page 60, specifically the lower right plot on the page.

I know that I can plot it with this:

qplot
(clarity,data=diamonds,geom='line',color=cut,stat='bin',group=cut)

but for the life of me, I cannot get it to work using ggplot as a
layered plot. I think I've tried every combination I can, but cannot
get anything out other than black lines with no legend on the right.

My last attempt looked something like this:

p<-ggplot(diamonds,aes(x=clarity,group=cut),color=cut)
p<-stat_bin(aes
(y=..count..,group=cut),color=cut,geom='line',position='identity')

Thanks in advance,
Joe

messages.author: 2d475b13e63c8cd2
messages.subject: Re: Newbie question on ggplot2 book
parts:
Hi Joe,

The following code gives you two options to reproduce the graph you
refer to:

dplot <- ggplot(diamonds, aes(x=clarity,group=cut,colour=cut))
dplot+geom_freqpoly()
dplot+stat_bin(geom="line",position="identity")

Scott
